name: Mosquitto MQTT clients
description: Installs the Eclipse Mosquitto MQTT clients (mosquitto_pub, mosquitto_sub, mosquitto_rr) at an exact upstream version you choose, e.g. 2.0.22: on Debian from repo.mosquitto.org, whose signing key the feature pins by fingerprint, on Ubuntu from the distro's own archive. The versions available differ by distro. There are no default pins.

version.description: Mosquitto clients version to install, as the upstream version (e.g. 2.0.22), with no leading v and no Debian revision. It must exist for your distro (see the notes). Set it here, or as CLI_MOSQUITTO_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set the version. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.
